"concepts": [
{"id": "c1", "name": "dcat:Catalog", "aliases": ["Catalog"], "description": "A catalog, which is a dataset in which each individual item is a metadata record describing some resource; its scope is collections of metadata about datasets, data services, or other resource types.", "anchor": "`dcat:Catalog` represents", "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0004"},
{"id": "c2", "name": "dcat:Resource", "aliases": ["Resource"], "description": "A dataset, a data service or any other resource that may be described by a metadata record in a catalog; not intended to be used directly, it is the parent class of the other cataloged resource classes and an extension point.", "anchor": "`dcat:Resource` represents", "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0004"},
{"id": "c3", "name": "dcat:Dataset", "aliases": ["Dataset"], "description": "A collection of data, published or curated by a single agent or identifiable community; the notion is broad and inclusive of resource types from all communities.", "anchor": "`dcat:Dataset` represents", "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0004"},
{"id": "c4", "name": "dcat:Distribution", "aliases": ["Distribution"], "description": "An accessible form of a dataset such as a downloadable file.", "anchor": "`dcat:Distribution` represents", "location": "w3c-dcat-3#c0004"},
